name: sportsos-next
description: SportsOS Next monorepo for sports management, live scoring, overlays, streaming, and hardware integrations.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sportsos/core && npm run build --workspace=@sportsos/config && npm run build --workspace=@sportsos/api && npm run build --workspace=@sportsos/dashboard
scripts.ci:prepare: npm run build --workspace=@sportsos/core && npm run build --workspace=@sportsos/config
scripts.ci:verify: npm run ci:prepare && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
